children: Saudi Arabia's Al Baha Municipality has completed the work on a 136-m-long walkway in Bani Hasan as part of its efforts to improve public spaces across the kingdom and support local commercial activity.

The 'Al-Ronq Walkway' combines pedestrian paths with investment kiosks, incorporating design elements inspired by the region’s architectural and heritage character, the municipality said in a statement.

The walkway features interlock-paved paths, decorative lighting and kiosks providing a range of services. The project is intended to encourage walking and shopping while providing space for local families and entrepreneurs to operate businesses, it added.
